name: Robed Initiate
description: A nervous member of the Cog and Key, guarding the secret society's inner sanctum.

initial_greeting.text: *starts* You! How did you get in here? The password! What's the password?!

correct_password.text: *relaxes* Ah, a fellow member. Forgive me, I'm new to the order. The inner chamber is through there. But be warned—the Grandmaster tolerates no failures.
